note: Ground truth for the wikimem retrieval benchmark (TRDD-DO6X4ZF8). Each query is a symptom phrase declared in the target atom's OWN `keywords:` list. Phrases that also appear in the page's `description:` were deliberately AVOIDED: a description hit resolves the PAGE, which would mask whether atom-level keyword recall works at all. `kw_pos` is the phrase's 1-based position in its atom's keyword list — the parser drops everything after the first comma, so a baseline where only kw_pos==1 succeeds is the expected shape of the Phase 1.3 defect, not a bug in this file. NOTE (TRDD-57WJL5L2): the 'do I need to retry after upload' query was REMOVED — its only target atom, `object-store-consistency#read-after-write-is-strong-now`, is deliberately `status: superseded` (its own `desc:` says the retry advice it carries is obsolete), and memgrep now default-EXCLUDES superseded atoms from search. There is no other current atom carrying that exact keyword phrase (the live guidance moved to a `[^N]` lesson, which this atom-level harness cannot target), so the query no longer has a valid ground-truth atom and was dropped rather than pointed at a target it cannot honestly test.
